gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of $47.7 million in prior year reserves for 2024. This release was less favourable than the previous year's release, primarily due to strengthening of reserves for potential losses related to the Russian invasion of Ukraine (Political Risk and Violence). This was partially offset by favourable claims development in Treaty, Property, and Casualty divisions, and a release related to the Covid-19 pandemic.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are taken from the Syndicate 1084 2024 annual report and are reported in USD. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 19 (Claims Outstanding balance at 1 January). Prior year release value is explicitly stated in the narrative; percentage is calculated relative to opening gross claims outstanding. Some LOB-specific reserve impacts are described qualitatively only (no amounts); mapping of 'Political Risk and Violence' to standard LOBs is approximate. Page references are best-effort based on the report's notes layout.
